title: ever CALISTEA|Deep V-neck Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning entrance in our Deep V-neck Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Formal Dress! This glamorous piece features sparkling sequins that catch the light beautifully, while the ruffle sleeves add a touch of playful elegance. Perfect for weddings, galas, or any special occasion, this dress ensures all eyes are on you!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Side back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
